title: phragmites communis subsp. maritimus
intro: Phragmites communis subsp. maritimus, commonly known as Sea Club-rush, is a type of grass found in coastal areas and salt marshes around the world. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sea Club-rush include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Sea Club-rush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
